reviews.x: I LOVED this lamp. However, It stopped working after 2 months.  I figured it was just a defect. I tried to contact the company about getting a new one or anything really because I love the company. However, they never responded to me. I gave them a month to respond bc I know they can get busy. I was so disappointed.  I ordered a different one from a company that gives a warranty with it.
I’ve used this lamp 2 times so far, and it’s great! Just started doing my own nails at home, and I’m supper happy with this purchase!

It takes longer for the nails to dry for sure than the suggested drying times. Used gelish color. Makkart top and base coat. I think for beginners that dont want to spend a lot on a lamp this is great. I'm still happy with my purchase. It does get the job done even if it does take longer to set the gel. Although obviously this means the lamp will last less hours of life than if it really would set the gels in the time that it is advertised to do so. It's okay though Im hoping it still lasts me a

reviews.t: Loved until it made my fingers dry...
reviews.x: Loved this lamp. Easy to use and it was a good deal until it ruined my fingers. After a bunch of uses it made my finger tips very very dry. The skin under and at the tip of my finger tips turned white and now they are peeling off. I had to discontinue use and wait for my fingers to heal. So disappointing as I never had problems at the salons. I was using it with the dips so I have to go back to the liquids instead of the gel
I love this lamp more than I love my firstborn child. I love sitting in my nail room with the door locked, doing my nails for hours. It's the only me time that I get.
I bought this mid January and three chord just blew up while it was plugged in and in use.
I like it. It cures well and I love that it counts as its curing.

This lamp is great. I’ve used it multiple times since purchasing and I really like it. I thought it was a great price when I got it, but now I see it’s even cheaper now :( that’s a bit disappointing. But the lamp is great, has a low and high power setting, I like having the multiple time buttons, and the inside is roomy.

Very much a useful lamp, it cures fast and it’s detachable from the base so you can do toes as well without touching feet to the lamp itself. The only reason I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars is because the cord coating tears easily and the wires to the outlet plug are exposed but some electrical tape will do the trick!

I am very satisfied with my purchase of the the Beetles Gel UV LED Nail light. The multiple timer settings are helpful and the light and fan work as promised.  The Gel polish is one of the best I have tried. The polish lasts for at least a week and half.

This is a nice nail light for price. A little flimsy but I haven’t run into any problems with the light or cord. Plus I was able to bundle it with their gel top coat and get a even better deal. I would recommend this to someone looking for a starter lamp
Super light and efficient! It may take a longer longer for nails to set but it’s worth it ! It gets  the job done. I would recommend if you don’t want to spend too much.
I used this two nights ago and went to use it agin today (only the second time using it) and it doesn’t work. Very disappointed.
Works great with the beetles polish.  Lasted quite a few days with out chipping!

reviews.t: It’s a great thing to have for beginner nail texts or lids who just wanna have fun
reviews.x: I think it’s a great light it cures within seconds and it’s so light and small
I use this for the polygel and does exactly what it’s supposed to do.

I've been using this since I bought it in December 2020 and I still love it. It is such a space saver compared to my high wattage UV-only lamp, and I don't have to worry about busting those UV tube-like bulbs.  I really like how this LED lamp doesn't heat up and fry my skin and works faster than the UV.  Just wish I could figure out how to get the count-UP timer to work again when I put my hand in without pushing a timer button.

Love everything about it! The phone stand actually holds my phone and the features are easy to use. One suggestion is for the buttons to be in-front of the phone stand next time as im doing my own nails but if using on someone else and they want to watch their phone its a good spot. Works really well, i bought this light to use alongside the beetles gel polishes and it worked beautifully

reviews.t: Not recommended for polygel unless you have patience
reviews.x: Takes a really long time to dry Polygel using dual forms. I had to do 3-4 90 second intervals and make sure you flip your hand over to cute as well because if not it will be sticky and cause it to set lumpy. I recommend a 48w uv led lamp if you don’t want to be curing your nails for so long. It cures gel polish with one 90second timer so that’s a plus just takes longer to cure the gel.

I’m on my second Beetles gel polish cure light and this one went out too. The first one went out when I was inside my window to return and of course now I can’t. I’ve only had this since May. It is now beginning of December and I’ve used it MAYBE five times. I don’t do my nails often at all. I’m a mother of four and live on a small mini farm.  Save your money pick something else

reviews.t: It’s was great until it wasn’t
reviews.x: I really liked this lamp. Didn’t use too often but when I did, it got the job done. Then it stopped working. It seems the cord is faulty. I would just buy another cord but how can I know which one will work. I wish they sold the cord separately so someone wouldn’t have to purchase another whole mail lamp.

I came across this lamp on sale while looking for nail powders figured for 13$ I would take the risk. DID NOT DISAPPOINT. But $13 I’ve spent love that it has to power options.  ( low/high). Cures my nails so quick and can do my whole hand at once! Will be recommending to all my friends ! 😍

reviews.t: Pretty awesome lamp for a beginner.!!!
reviews.x: This is my first time using gel only used a few times. It dries well. Love settings for curing. I only have beetles polish.  I even sandwiched a nail stamp on them.  I have had them stay on few days only because I  need to change polish often as I get bored easily.  Worth the price

reviews.t: i wish it worked but the company was super nice about it
reviews.x: it's did not work when i got it but the company was super easy to get a hold of and they even offered to replace it right away or get my money back. if it does not work they will send you a new one and the company responded very quickly and was so polite about it.

So far I’ve only used it once but it worked so good! It dried my nails really fast and I’m very pleased with this product. It’s very good to have during this time when the salons are closed. But honestly I might just stick to doing my own nails from now on.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the lamp works well and cures nails effectively, often calling it great or efficient.
Several reviewers note it takes longer than the suggested times for nails to fully set or dry.
Some reviewers report durability problems, including the lamp stopping working or the cord failing shortly after purchase.
Reviewers frequently describe it as a good value or a great option for beginners who don't want to spend much.
A few reviewers mention issues with the cord coating tearing or exposed wires, and one reports finger dryness and peeling.
